_provenance.source: PRODUCT.md (ordering channels, address, phone, hours) and the printed menu transcription in menu.json (landmark, catering).
_provenance.note: This is the canonical runtime source for hours, contact details, and ordering channels. menu.json also carries a contact block, but that is a record of what the printed menu says — a transcription artifact. Components read from here.
_provenance.verifyBeforeLaunch: Re-confirm hours and phone with the restaurant along with the menu price check.

contact.landmark: Across from the Post Office, in Glen Oaks Shopping Center

hours.holidayNote: Holiday hours may differ — call ahead.

ordering.note: Ordering happens on these channels, never on this site. URLs are canonical store links — Google search tracking parameters (rwg_token, utm_*) were stripped deliberately; they are tied to a single search click and do not belong in permanent markup.

direct.walkInLabel: Or walk in — dine-in and takeout both welcome
